def draft_from_file(data, source, *, kind, project, scope, work, carrier, version, decision, schema_source=None, contract_source=None, owner=None):
    """Return an inert candidate and its complete original native target; no writes."""
    require(kind in ('definition', 'record', 'artifact-type'), 'unknown-creation-kind')
    require(scope in ('project', 'work'), 'invalid-draft-scope')
    require(scope != 'work' or isinstance(work, str) and bool(work), 'work-required')
    require(scope != 'project' or work is None, 'project-scope-has-work')

operation CreateRecord:
  input request CreationRequest
  input branch Branch
  output RecordDraft
  enforce RecordCreationEligibility(request=request,branch=branch)
  return ToRecordDraft(request)

rule DraftsBelongToBranch:
  input branch Branch
  input drafts List<RecordDraft,16>
  expression length(drafts) > 0 and fold(drafts,true,valid:Bool,item:RecordDraft => valid and item.project == branch.project and item.status == CandidateDraft and item.target.effect == Admit and absent(item.target.predecessor) and present(item.target.authored_record) and (item.target.category == Definition or item.target.category == ArtifactInstance or item.target.category == ArtifactType) and length(filter(drafts,other:RecordDraft => other.identity_ref == item.identity_ref)) == 1 and length(filter(drafts,other:RecordDraft => other.target.decision == item.target.decision)) == 1)
operation PrepareCreation:
  input branch Branch

def dispatch(profile,catalog,operation,arguments=(),*,project_ref=None,goal_ref=None,store=None,root=ROOT):
    """Run existing native commands; no extra mutation/permission route is introduced."""
    selected=resolve(profile,catalog,project_ref=project_ref,goal_ref=goal_ref)
    need(operation in READ_OPERATIONS|PROJECT_OPERATIONS,"unsupported-workspace-operation")
    need(not any(a in ("--repo","--store") or a.startswith(("--repo=","--store=")) for a in arguments),"dispatch-context-override")
    entry=Path(selected["entrypoint"])
